title: Noct hình thái 2 · attack (rút kiếm iai)
style: Static locked camera, three-quarter FRONT view facing screen-right, matching the reference (his front and glowing eyes visible, never his back), the whole body, katana and scabbard always inside the frame with a margin, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hood, cloak, tassels and loose cloth always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: A

Locked stationary camera; no turning or scale change; his size stays the same in every frame. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the action; the hood, cloak and tassels follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve his identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid katana, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added effects, aura, glow, dust or particles.

pick_note: noto = the draw reversed: K s7 5/9 (U -> D), then D, B s7 5, B s7 3, R
sharpen_note: This hero never shows a face: under the hood there is only shadow and two glowing pale aqua eyes, exactly as in the resting frame. The katana is always ONE whole rigid straight steel blade with a pale-aqua wrapped hilt; the scabbard is plain black. No glow or trail on the blade. His LEFT hand is on the far side of his body: never draw a hand holding the scabbard behind his back hip; behind him only the scabbard shows, coming out from behind his body. The hilt has ONE fixed short length (the pale-aqua wrapped grip is only a little longer than his fist, as in the resting frame); it never grows. While he draws, the part of the katana between the front edge of his body and his right fist is bright STEEL blade (silver-white, a thin straight blade), growing longer frame by frame as the fist moves forward; the rest of the blade is hidden behind his body. When something long sticks out FORWARD past his right fist (the blade whipping round for the cut), it is the silver STEEL blade, even where the soft frame tints it green or aqua: draw it as thin bright steel, with only the short aqua grip inside his fist.
